name: Repelling Motherboard (Outstanding)
description: This item gains the repelling property, but the DC to interrupt or dispel your powers is equal to 10 + the power's level, or 8 + twice your proficiency bonus + your casting modifier for that power, whichever is greater. Additionally, creatures always have disadvantage on ability checks to dispel or interrupt your powers, and when a creatures make an ability check to dispel or interrupt your powers with disadvantage, they must reroll one of the dice once (your choice).
